1.2.0: IF COL_LENGTH('subscrio.product_features','composition_rule') IS NULL ALTER TABLE subscrio.product_features ADD composition_rule NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'override_wins' CHECK (composition_rule IN ('additive','most_generous','override_wins'))

IF COL_LENGTH('subscrio.product_features','cross_subscription_rule') IS NULL ALTER TABLE subscrio.product_features ADD cross_subscription_rule NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'legacy' CHECK (cross_subscription_rule IN ('legacy','additive','most_generous','override_wins'))
IF COL_LENGTH('subscrio.subscription_feature_overrides','expires_at') IS NULL ALTER TABLE subscrio.subscription_feature_overrides ADD expires_at DATETIMEOFFSET
ALTER TABLE subscrio.product_features ADD CONSTRAINT composition_rule_valid CHECK (composition_rule IN ('additive','most_generous','override_wins'))
ALTER TABLE subscrio.product_features ADD CONSTRAINT cross_subscription_rule_valid CHECK (cross_subscription_rule IN ('legacy','additive','most_generous','override_wins'))

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.check_constraints WHERE name='override_expiry_valid') ALTER TABLE subscrio.subscription_feature_overrides ADD CONSTRAINT override_expiry_valid CHECK ((override_type='timed' AND expires_at IS NOT NULL) OR (override_type IN ('permanent','temporary') AND expires_at IS NULL))

IF OBJECT_ID(N'subscrio.addons',N'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE subscrio.addons (id BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY, product_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES subscrio.products(id), [key] NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE, display_name NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, description NVARCHAR(MAX), status NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK(status IN ('active','archived')), composition_mode NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'additive' CHECK(composition_mode IN ('additive','override')), priority INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, metadata NVARCHAR(MAX), created_at DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME(), updated_at DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME())

IF OBJECT_ID(N'subscrio.addon_features',N'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE subscrio.addon_features (id BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY, addon_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES subscrio.addons(id), feature_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES subscrio.features(id), value NVARCHAR(MAX) NOT NULL, created_at DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME(), updated_at DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME(), UNIQUE(addon_id,feature_id))

IF OBJECT_ID(N'subscrio.subscription_addons',N'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE subscrio.subscription_addons (id BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY, subscription_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES subscrio.subscriptions(id), addon_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES subscrio.addons(id), quantity INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(quantity>0), status NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK(status IN ('active','cancelled')), created_at DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME(), updated_at DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME(), UNIQUE(subscription_id,addon_id))
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE name='addons_product_status' AND object_id=OBJECT_ID('subscrio.addons')) CREATE INDEX addons_product_status ON subscrio.addons(product_id,status)

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE name='subscription_addons_status' AND object_id=OBJECT_ID('subscrio.subscription_addons')) CREATE INDEX subscription_addons_status ON subscrio.subscription_addons(subscription_id,status)
1.3.0: IF OBJECT_ID(N'subscrio.metered_feature_config',N'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE subscrio.metered_feature_config (id BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY, feature_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES subscrio.features(id) UNIQUE, reset_period NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL CHECK(reset_period IN ('hourly','daily','weekly','monthly','yearly','billing_period')), enforcement NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL CHECK(enforcement IN ('hard','soft')), aggregation NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL CHECK(aggregation IN ('count','sum')), scope NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL CHECK(scope IN ('customer','subscription')), created_at DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME(), updated_at DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME(), CHECK(reset_period!='billing_period' OR scope='subscription'))

IF OBJECT_ID(N'subscrio.usage_balances',N'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE subscrio.usage_balances (id BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY, customer_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES subscrio.customers(id), product_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES subscrio.products(id), feature_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES subscrio.features(id), subscription_id BIGINT  REFERENCES subscrio.subscriptions(id), period_start DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL, period_end DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL, consumed BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (consumed BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991), limit_value BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (limit_value BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991), updated_at DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME(), CHECK(period_end>period_start))

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE name='usage_customer_period' AND object_id=OBJECT_ID('subscrio.usage_balances')) CREATE UNIQUE INDEX usage_customer_period ON subscrio.usage_balances(customer_id,product_id,feature_id,period_start) WHERE subscription_id IS NULL

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE name='usage_subscription_period' AND object_id=OBJECT_ID('subscrio.usage_balances')) CREATE UNIQUE INDEX usage_subscription_period ON subscrio.usage_balances(customer_id,product_id,feature_id,subscription_id,period_start) WHERE subscription_id IS NOT NULL

IF OBJECT_ID(N'subscrio.usage_events',N'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE subscrio.usage_events (id BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY, idempotency_key NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, request_hash NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, usage_balance_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES subscrio.usage_balances(id), customer_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES subscrio.customers(id), product_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES subscrio.products(id), feature_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES subscrio.features(id), subscription_id BIGINT  REFERENCES subscrio.subscriptions(id), quantity BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991), recorded_at DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL, metadata NVARCHAR(MAX), result_snapshot NVARCHAR(MAX) NOT NULL, created_at DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME(), UNIQUE(customer_id,idempotency_key))

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE name='usage_events_history' AND object_id=OBJECT_ID('subscrio.usage_events')) CREATE INDEX usage_events_history ON subscrio.usage_events(customer_id,product_id,feature_id,recorded_at,id)

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE name='usage_events_balance' AND object_id=OBJECT_ID('subscrio.usage_events')) CREATE INDEX usage_events_balance ON subscrio.usage_events(usage_balance_id)
1.4.0: IF OBJECT_ID(N'subscrio.credit_currencies',N'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE subscrio.credit_currencies (id BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY, [key] NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE, display_name NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, status NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK(status IN ('active','archived')), metadata NVARCHAR(MAX), created_at DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME(), updated_at DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME())

IF OBJECT_ID(N'subscrio.plan_credit_grants',N'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE subscrio.plan_credit_grants (id BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY, plan_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES subscrio.plans(id), credit_currency_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES subscrio.credit_currencies(id), amount BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (amount BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991), cadence NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL CHECK(cadence IN ('once','monthly','yearly','billing_period')), expiry_policy NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL CHECK(expiry_policy IN ('none','grant_period_end')), cancellation_policy NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL CHECK(cancellation_policy IN ('retain','expire')), is_active BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, created_at DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME(), updated_at DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME(), UNIQUE(plan_id,credit_currency_id))

IF OBJECT_ID(N'subscrio.subscription_credit_grant_states',N'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE subscrio.subscription_credit_grant_states (id BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY, subscription_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES subscrio.subscriptions(id), credit_currency_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES subscrio.credit_currencies(id), anchor_at DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL, next_due_at DATETIMEOFFSET, once_issued_at DATETIMEOFFSET, rule_snapshot NVARCHAR(MAX) NOT NULL, created_at DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME(), updated_at DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME(), UNIQUE(subscription_id,credit_currency_id))

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE name='credit_grant_schedule_due' AND object_id=OBJECT_ID('subscrio.subscription_credit_grant_states')) CREATE INDEX credit_grant_schedule_due ON subscrio.subscription_credit_grant_states(next_due_at)

IF OBJECT_ID(N'subscrio.credit_wallets',N'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE subscrio.credit_wallets (id BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY, customer_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES subscrio.customers(id), credit_currency_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES subscrio.credit_currencies(id), created_at DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME(), updated_at DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME(), UNIQUE(customer_id,credit_currency_id))

IF OBJECT_ID(N'subscrio.credit_operations',N'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE subscrio.credit_operations (id BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY, customer_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES subscrio.customers(id), idempotency_key NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, operation_type NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, request_hash NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, result_snapshot NVARCHAR(MAX) NOT NULL, created_at DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME(), UNIQUE(customer_id,idempotency_key))

IF OBJECT_ID(N'subscrio.credit_grants',N'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE subscrio.credit_grants (id BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY, wallet_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES subscrio.credit_wallets(id), subscription_id BIGINT  REFERENCES subscrio.subscriptions(id), plan_credit_grant_id BIGINT  REFERENCES subscrio.plan_credit_grants(id), source_key NVARCHAR(255), grant_type NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL CHECK(grant_type IN ('recurring','prepaid','promotional','manual')), original_amount BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (original_amount BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991), remaining_amount BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (remaining_amount BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991), priority INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, expires_at DATETIMEOFFSET, grant_period_start DATETIMEOFFSET, grant_period_end DATETIMEOFFSET, cancellation_policy NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'retain' CHECK(cancellation_policy IN ('retain','expire')), created_at DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME(), updated_at DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME(), CHECK(remaining_amount<=original_amount))

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE name='credit_grants_burn_order' AND object_id=OBJECT_ID('subscrio.credit_grants')) CREATE INDEX credit_grants_burn_order ON subscrio.credit_grants(wallet_id,priority,expires_at,id)

IF OBJECT_ID(N'subscrio.credit_ledger_entries',N'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE subscrio.credit_ledger_entries (id BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY, operation_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES subscrio.credit_operations(id), wallet_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES subscrio.credit_wallets(id), credit_grant_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES subscrio.credit_grants(id), amount BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(amount BETWEEN -9007199254740991 AND 9007199254740991 AND amount<>0), reason NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL CHECK(reason IN ('grant','consumption','expiry','adjustment','cancellation')), feature_id BIGINT  REFERENCES subscrio.features(id), product_id BIGINT  REFERENCES subscrio.products(id), metadata NVARCHAR(MAX), created_at DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME(), UNIQUE(operation_id,credit_grant_id,reason))

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE name='credit_ledger_history' AND object_id=OBJECT_ID('subscrio.credit_ledger_entries')) CREATE INDEX credit_ledger_history ON subscrio.credit_ledger_entries(wallet_id,created_at,id)

IF OBJECT_ID(N'subscrio.credit_consumption_rules',N'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE subscrio.credit_consumption_rules (id BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY, feature_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES subscrio.features(id), credit_currency_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES subscrio.credit_currencies(id), credits_per_unit BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (credits_per_unit BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991), created_at DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME(), updated_at DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME(), UNIQUE(feature_id,credit_currency_id))
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE name='credit_grants_source_key') CREATE UNIQUE INDEX credit_grants_source_key ON subscrio.credit_grants(source_key) WHERE source_key IS NOT NULL
